sources.title: Proximus plans 1,200 job cuts by 2030 | VRT NWS: news
sources.description: The part state-owned Telecom company Proximus has announced plans to shed 1,200 jobs between now and 2030. The company says that it will reduce its workforce in a “controlled and gradual” manner over the next few years. The company also announced a halving of the dividends it will pay its shareholders following an 11% fall in net profits.
